content:
You plan to visit 8 European cities for 17 days in total. You only take direct flights to commute between cities. You plan to stay in Reykjavik for 2 days. You want to meet a friend in Reykjavik between day 3 and day 4. You plan to stay in Stockholm for 2 days. You would like to meet your friends at Stockholm between day 4 and day 5 to tour together. You would like to visit Porto for 5 days. You are going to attend a wedding in Porto between day 13 and day 17. You want to spend 3 days in Nice. You want to spend 4 days in Venice. You plan to stay in Vienna for 3 days. You have to attend a workshop in Vienna between day 11 and day 13. You would like to visit Split for 3 days. You want to spend 2 days in Copenhagen.

Here are the cities that have direct flights:
Copenhagen and Vienna, Nice and Stockholm, Split and Copenhagen, Nice and Reykjavik, Nice and Porto, Reykjavik and Vienna, Stockholm and Copenhagen, Nice and Venice, Nice and Vienna, Reykjavik and Copenhagen, Nice and Copenhagen, Stockholm and Vienna, Venice and Vienna, Copenhagen and Porto, Reykjavik and Stockholm, Stockholm and Split, Split and Vienna, Copenhagen and Venice, Vienna and Porto.

Find a trip plan of visiting the cities for 17 days by taking direct flights to commute between them.

Please output the trip plan in the following JSON format:
{"itinerary": [{"day_range": "Day X-Y", "place": "<CITY>"}]}. Include all city visits with their day ranges. Do not include separate flight entries in the JSON output.

IMPORTANT: When you fly from city A to city B on day X, that day counts for BOTH cities. For example:
- If you stay in Venice from Day 1-3 and fly to Vienna on Day 3, then:
  - Venice: Day 1-3 (3 days)
  - Vienna: Day 3-6 (4 days, including the flight day)
- The flight day (Day 3) is counted for both Venice and Vienna.
- Do NOT create separate flight entries in the JSON.

{
  "itinerary": [
    { "day_range": "Day 1-3", "place": "Nice" },
    { "day_range": "Day 3-4", "place": "Reykjavik" },
    { "day_range": "Day 4-5", "place": "Stockholm" },
    { "day_range": "Day 5-7", "place": "Split" },
    { "day_range": "Day 7-8", "place": "Copenhagen" },
    { "day_range": "Day 8-11", "place": "Venice" },
    { "day_range": "Day 11-13", "place": "Vienna" },
    { "day_range": "Day 13-17", "place": "Porto" }
  ]
} 

/* Explanation of the plan:

We must visit eight cities with total “duration sum” 24 days (Nice 3, Reykjavik 2, Stockholm 2, Split 3, Copenhagen 2, Venice 4, Vienna 3, Porto 5). When flying, the day of the flight counts for both the departing and arriving cities, so the overall calendar time is 24 – 7 = 17 days.

Key event constraints:
• Reykjavik (2 days) is scheduled for Day 3–4 so that you can meet your friend there between day 3 and 4.
• Stockholm (2 days) is scheduled for Day 4–5 so that you can meet your friends between day 4 and 5.
• Vienna (3 days) is scheduled for Day 11–13 so that you can attend your workshop within that window.
• Porto (5 days) is put at the end (Day 13–17) which accommodates the wedding event between day 13 and 17.

Flight connections (all segments use direct flights from the provided list) are:
Nice → Reykjavik (via “Nice and Reykjavik”),
Reykjavik → Stockholm (“Reykjavik and Stockholm”),
Stockholm → Split (“Stockholm and Split”),
Split → Copenhagen (“Split and Copenhagen”),
Copenhagen → Venice (“Copenhagen and Venice”),
Venice → Vienna (“Venice and Vienna”),
Vienna → Porto (“Vienna and Porto”).

The day‐by‐day breakdown is as follows:
– Nice: Day 1–3 (3 days)
– Reykjavik: Day 3–4 (2 days; flight on day 3 overlaps with Nice, and meeting can occur on day 3 or 4)
– Stockholm: Day 4–5 (2 days; flight on day 4 overlaps with Reykjavik, meeting possible on day 4 or 5)
– Split: Day 5–7 (3 days)
– Copenhagen: Day 7–8 (2 days)
– Venice: Day 8–11 (4 days)
– Vienna: Day 11–13 (3 days; workshop can happen on day 11–13)
– Porto: Day 13–17 (5 days; wedding between day 13 and 17)

This itinerary meets all the duration, connection and event constraints. */
